caption:
Stop debating who a good person is. Practice it today.

Send this to someone who thinks a lot about doing better.

From "The 14-Day Clarity Reset." Copy and paste the link in bio.

#clarity #marcusaurelius #stoicism #action #mindset

text: “Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.”
It is easy to think about who you want to be.
It is harder to act like that person today.
Planning can become a way of waiting.
Marcus wrote this to himself.
It was a private reminder, not a speech.
You do not need a perfect definition.
You need one small act that fits it.
Try this today:
Pick one thing a person you admire would do.
Do it before noon.
Character is built from small actions repeated.
Not from conclusions reached.
What is one thing you can do today instead of debating?
This is the thread behind the book *The 14-Day Clarity Reset*.
Clarity shows up in what you do, not what you plan.
Do one thing.
*Be the person.*

caption:
Certainty feels strong. Doubt is often wiser.

Save this, then notice one thing today you were too sure about.

From "The Science of Learning Your Inner Speech." Copy and paste the link in bio.

#innerspeech #bertrandrussell #doubt #selfawareness #thinking

text: “The stupid are cocksure while the intelligent are full of doubt.”
Russell wrote this in 1933.
It still lands.
Certainty feels like confidence.
Often it is just the absence of questions.
Your inner voice can sound very sure.
Loud is not the same as right.
Doubt is not weakness.
It is a sign you are still paying attention.
Try this today:
When your inner voice says *obviously*,
ask: *how do I know?*
You will not lose your convictions.
You will just hold them with open hands.
What are you most certain about that you have never tested?
This is the thread behind the book *The Science of Learning Your Inner Speech*.
Listening for the voice that sounds too sure.
Question the certainty.
*Keep it honest.*
